title: UAE National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence 2031
status_note: A strategy document. Its text does not state a legal force of its own, so this product does not describe it as binding.
reading_notes: Page 1 (cover) and page 25 (back cover) have no text layer and are OCR-derived.
Page 23 holds the conclusion and the reference list in one text run, so it is stored but excluded from retrieval, as are the cover, contents and back pages.

title: The UAE Charter for the Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence (July 2024)
source_note: PDF saved from the research pass. The URL is the public page, not the PDF address (see sources/README.md).
status_note: A charter of general principles. Its own text calls it a guiding framework, so this product does not describe it as binding.
heading_pattern: ^(\d{1,2}\. .+:|Relation to the UAE AI Strategy:|General Principles of the Charter:|Introduction)\s*$
reading_notes: The text layer does not map the 'Th' and 'ff' ligature glyphs. They are stored as U+FFFD, not repaired. Rendered pages were checked by eye: 'The UAE' appears in the PDF where the stored text has a replacement character.
On page 3 the text layer places some principle headings after their paragraphs. Section labels on Charter citations were confirmed against the rendered page.

title: Artificial Intelligence Ethics: Principles and Guidelines (December 2022)
status_note: Guidance. Its own text says the guidelines are non-binding and non-mandatory. It covers public and private sectors and only systems that make or inform significant decisions.
reading_notes: Published under CC BY 4.0 per its section 1.5: credit to the UAE AI and Blockchain Council as owner, and no suggestion of endorsement by the Minister of State office.
Each PDF page is a two-page spread, so one PDF page carries two printed page numbers. Citations use the PDF page index.

The text layer often separates headings and list letters from their paragraphs. Section labels on rule citations were confirmed against the rendered page. Page-level headings on other chunks only say which headings occur on that page.
Pages 23 and 24 (bibliography) and the table of contents are stored but excluded from retrieval, because a bibliography entry is not a provision.

title: AI Adoption Guideline in Government Services (Ministry of Cabinet Affairs)
analogy_note: This guideline is about government services and this track is telecom. Applied here by analogy only.
status_note: A guideline addressed to government and agencies delivering public sector services. It does not address telecom operators, and this product does not describe it as binding.

self_description.quote:
The target audience of this document is the UAE Government and any agency 
engaged in delivering public sector services.
